import React, { useEffect } from 'react'; import { usePageMeta } from '../hooks/usePageMeta'; import './Policy.css'; const PaymentPolicy = () => { usePageMeta({ title: 'Booking & Payment Policy | Dune Explorer', description: 'Booking, payment, and cancellation policy for Dune Explorer luxury tours.', }); useEffect(() => { window.scrollTo(0, 0); }, []); return (

Booking & Cancellation Policy

At DuneXplore, we believe in providing a seamless and transparent booking experience. Please read our booking and cancellation policy carefully before confirming your journey.

Booking Policy

To secure your reservation, an advance payment of 30% of the total tour cost is required at the time of booking. Your booking will be confirmed once the advance payment has been received and acknowledged by DuneXplore.

The remaining 70% balance must be paid at least 30 days prior to your scheduled arrival or travel date. For bookings made within 30 days of departure, full payment may be required at the time of confirmation.

All bookings are subject to availability of hotels, transportation, guides, safari permits, and other travel services. Once confirmed, you will receive your booking confirmation and final itinerary via email.

Payment Methods

We offer secure and convenient payment options for our guests worldwide.

  • Credit/Debit Card: A payment processing fee of 3.5% will be applicable to the total transaction amount.
  • Bank/Wire Transfer: Guests are responsible for any bank charges, intermediary fees, or international transfer costs associated with the transaction.

Cancellation & Refund Policy

If you need to cancel your booking, please notify us in writing by emailing info@dunexplore.com.

Refunds will be processed according to the following schedule:

Cancellation Period Refund
30 days or more before arrival 95% refund (5% cancellation fee applies)
15ΓÇô29 days before arrival 70% refund
7ΓÇô14 days before arrival 40% refund
Less than 7 days before arrival or No Show No Refund

Where applicable, approved refunds will be processed within 20 business days from the date of cancellation confirmation.

Bookings Made Through Third-Party Partners

If your reservation has been made through an online travel agency, travel advisor, or any third-party booking platform, the cancellation and refund policy of the respective provider may apply.

Where DuneXplore's policy is applicable, the following refund schedule will be followed:

Cancellation Period Refund
60 days or more before arrival 80% refund
59ΓÇô28 days before arrival 60% refund
27ΓÇô15 days before arrival 30% refund
Within 14 days before arrival or No Show No Refund

Refunds for third-party bookings are subject to the respective booking partner's processing timelines and terms. DuneXplore cannot guarantee refund timelines where payments have been collected by a third-party platform.

Important Information

  • Wildlife safari permits, including those for Ranthambore, Jawai, and other national parks, are non-refundable once confirmed, as they are governed by government regulations.
  • Bookings made during Christmas, New Year, festival periods, or other designated peak travel dates may be non-refundable or subject to special cancellation terms communicated at the time of booking.
  • Domestic flight tickets, train tickets, and certain hotel reservations are subject to the cancellation policies of the respective airline, railway, hotel, or service provider. Applicable supplier charges will be deducted from any eligible refund.
  • Any amendment to a confirmed itinerary, including changes to travel dates, destinations, accommodation, or services, will be subject to availability and may incur additional charges.
  • In the event of unforeseen circumstances such as extreme weather, natural disasters, government restrictions, political unrest, or other force majeure events, DuneXplore will make every reasonable effort to offer suitable alternatives; however, additional costs incurred due to such events may be the responsibility of the traveler.

Need Assistance?

If you have any questions regarding your booking or cancellation, our team will be happy to assist you.

DuneXplore

Stories

The Story Behind DuneXplore

Beyond Travel, Into Experience

There are journeys that take you to new places, and then there are journeys that change the way you see the world. DuneXplore was born from the second kind.

Growing up in Rajasthan, I was surrounded by magnificent forts, timeless palaces, vibrant markets, colourful festivals, and stories that had been passed down through generations. To me, these weren't just tourist attractionsΓÇöthey were part of everyday life. As I travelled across different parts of India, I realized that every destination had its own soul, its own people, and its own story waiting to be discovered.

What inspired me most wasn't simply travellingΓÇöit was witnessing the joy on people's faces when they experienced a place in a way they never expected. A quiet sunrise over the Aravalli Hills. A conversation with a local artisan whose family had practised the same craft for generations. The silence of the Thar Desert beneath a sky full of stars. A family sharing traditional Rajasthani cuisine with guests from halfway across the world. Those moments cannot be found in guidebooks; they become memories that stay with you forever.

That's why I created DuneXplore.
Not to sell holidays, but to create journeys that people remember for the rest of their lives.

Every itinerary we design is personal. Every recommendation is carefully chosen. Every hotel, every local experience, every heritage walk, every wildlife safari, and every hidden gem is selected with one purposeΓÇöto help our guests experience India as more than just visitors.

We believe luxury is not only about staying in beautiful hotels or travelling in comfort. True luxury is having the freedom to experience a destination without worrying about the details. It's watching the sunrise at the Taj Mahal before the crowds arrive. It's sharing stories with local communities, dining in centuries-old palaces, spotting a leopard in the wild, or discovering a quiet street that isn't found on most travel maps.

These are the experiences that become lifelong memories.

But DuneXplore is about more than our storyΓÇöit is about yours.

Every traveller who joins us brings a different dream, a different perspective, and a different reason for exploring India. Whether you're celebrating a honeymoon, travelling with family, seeking adventure, or simply fulfilling a lifelong dream, your journey becomes part of the DuneXplore story.

This space is where we'll share those momentsΓÇöour experiences, your experiences, travel inspiration, hidden discoveries, and the unforgettable memories created along the way. We hope these stories inspire others to explore with curiosity, travel with purpose, and appreciate the beauty of meaningful experiences.

Because at the end of every journey, we don't remember the number of kilometres we travelled or the hotels we stayed in.

We remember the people we met, the stories we heard, the places that touched our hearts, and the memories that changed us forever.

Welcome to the DuneXplore family.

Let's build a community of travellers who believe that the best journeys aren't measured by destinations, but by the experiences they create.

DuneXplore Beyond Travel, Into Experience.

Terms & Conditions

Welcome to DuneXplore. By accessing our website, requesting a quotation, making a booking, or using any of our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions. These terms govern the relationship between DuneXplore ("we," "our," or "us") and every customer ("you" or "traveler") using our website or travel services.

1. Our Services

DuneXplore specializes in creating bespoke travel experiences across Rajasthan and India. Our services include customized itineraries, luxury holidays, heritage tours, wildlife safaris, transportation, hotel reservations, guided sightseeing, cultural experiences, destination management, and other travel-related services. All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation from our travel partners.

2. Booking & Confirmation

A booking is considered confirmed only after we receive the required advance payment and issue a written booking confirmation. Any itinerary shared before confirmation is a proposed itinerary and may be modified due to availability, operational requirements, weather conditions, government regulations, or other circumstances beyond our control.

Customized itineraries may require additional planning and pricing. DuneXplore reserves the right to accept or decline any booking request without assigning a reason.

3. Payment Policy

To confirm a booking, an advance payment of 20% of the total tour cost is required unless otherwise agreed in writing.

The remaining balance must be paid at least 30 days before the commencement of the tour. Failure to complete payment within the specified period may result in cancellation of the booking, and the advance payment may be forfeited.

For bookings made within 30 days of departure, full payment may be required at the time of confirmation.

4. Cancellation & Refund Policy

Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing by email to info@dunexplore.com.

Refunds will be processed according to the following schedule:

  • More than 60 days before arrival: 80% refund (20% cancellation fee or deposit amount, whichever is higher)
  • 59ΓÇô28 days before arrival: 60% refund

Please note that flights, train tickets, hotels, permits, safaris, and other third-party services may have separate cancellation policies. In such cases, the respective supplier's cancellation charges will apply and may be non-refundable.

5. Changes to Bookings

If you wish to modify your itinerary after confirmation, we will make every reasonable effort to accommodate your request. However, changes are subject to availability and may incur additional charges.

DuneXplore reserves the right to make reasonable changes to itineraries where necessary due to weather, road conditions, government regulations, operational requirements, or unforeseen circumstances while ensuring a comparable travel experience whenever possible.

6. Traveler Responsibilities

Travelers are responsible for ensuring they possess valid passports, visas, travel insurance, vaccination certificates (if applicable), and any other travel documents required by the destination.

Guests are also responsible for arriving at departure points on time, complying with local laws and regulations, respecting local customs, and following safety instructions provided by guides and service providers.

Any expenses of a personal nature, including meals not mentioned in the itinerary, shopping, beverages, laundry, tips, telephone charges, medical expenses, or optional activities, shall be borne by the traveler.

7. Third-Party Services

DuneXplore works with carefully selected hotels, airlines, transportation providers, activity operators, guides, and other travel partners. While we carefully choose our partners, these services are operated independently.

We are not responsible for delays, cancellations, schedule changes, service interruptions, overbooking, strikes, technical failures, or any acts or omissions of third-party suppliers.

8. Force Majeure

DuneXplore shall not be held liable for delays, modifications, or cancellation of services resulting from events beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, floods, earthquakes, pandemics, political unrest, war, government restrictions, airline disruptions, road closures, extreme weather, strikes, or other unforeseen events.

In such situations, we will make every reasonable effort to provide suitable alternatives; however, additional costs arising from such circumstances may be payable by the traveler.

9. Limitation of Liability

DuneXplore acts as a travel planner and facilitator. Our liability is limited to the travel arrangements directly organized by us.

We shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or special loss, including loss of enjoyment, missed flights, delays, personal injury, illness, theft, loss of baggage, or damage arising from the actions of third-party suppliers or events beyond our control.

10. Intellectual Property

No content may be copied, reproduced, modified, distributed, or used for commercial purposes without prior written permission.

11. Privacy

Your privacy is important to us. Personal information collected through our website or during the booking process is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and is used only to provide travel services, process bookings, and improve your experience.

12. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
